final: WITH rating_rates AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rate FROM film GROUP BY rating), cross_rating_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_rate) AS avg_rate FROM rating_rates) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_replacement_cost, r.avg_per_day_rate, r.avg_per_day_rate - c.avg_rate AS above_cross_rating_average FROM rating_rates r CROSS JOIN cross_rating_avg c WHERE r.avg_per_day_rate > c.avg_rate ORDER BY r.rating
